title: Gibbard-Satterthwaite theorem (strategy-proof social choice)
summary: Formalizes the Gibbard-Satterthwaite theorem for finite electorates and finite alternative sets with at least three alternatives: every onto, strategy-proof social choice function is dictatorial. The proof constructs a social welfare function and reduces to Arrow's impossibility theorem.

formalizes.title: Manipulation of voting schemes: A general result
Strategy-proofness and Arrow's conditions: Existence and correspondence theorems for voting procedures and social welfare functions

review.reason: Lean formalization of the Gibbard-Satterthwaite theorem via reduction to Arrow's theorem.
